question: Does the ~70 % right-sheet line hold on s022814's own labelled window, with full-sheet hops built on the organizers' surface (nothing from w00)?
window: the organizers' labelled next-turn surface s022814 of PHerc0841, its labelled-text window (20 x 11.7 mm), canonical 2.4 um ink model at a fixed +1 layer offset; tiles cut to the common frame shared with line_spacing's pictures

levels.ctrl814: readable control: the organizers' undamaged s022814 surface over its labelled text window, fixed offset +1 layer (~2.4 um)
levels.L85_814: descriptive: top 15 % of a dispersed mask hopped a full sheet (s022814 normal; nearest public m7 run 170-250 um out, else a constant 200 um), +1 layer
levels.L70_814: primary: top 30 % hopped a full sheet (same law), +1 layer
levels.L55_814: guard: top 45 % hopped a full sheet, nested (contains every L70_814 hop plus 15 % more), +1 layer

pictures.calib: calibration: a known-rows ink map of another public fragment's known text (not this window), a picture both raters had rated before
pictures.calib_blank: the calibration map in the wrong layer order (wrong-order blank)

other_test_on_page.O2: line_spacing primary: 10 constant-height lines cut from s022814 itself, 2.02 mm apart, joined by the frozen sheet-direction fill (12 fill rows per gap), depth picked by the window's own labels (best of 7)
other_test_on_page.O45: line_spacing secondary: the same builder with 5 lines 4.54 mm apart (24 fill rows per gap), own label-picked depth

hop_law: nearest public m7 run 170-250 um outward along s022814's normal, else a constant 200 um (the pre-written 170 fallback: at floor 140 a moved patch still showed the true text)
sitting: same sitting as fullhop_w (Chris then Sebastien); the line_spacing pictures never count here

rule.valid_rater: every own picture of this test and the calibration pair answered; calibration rows; the calibration blank, ctrl814 blank and L70_814 blank each not rows. A valid rater who does not call ctrl814 rows is undecided for this window

outcomes.FAILS-814: >= 1 valid rater with ctrl814 rows calls L70_814 not rows
outcomes.HOLDS-814: both valid raters call ctrl814 and L70_814 rows, AND >= 1 of them calls H50_814 or L55_814 not rows
outcomes.UNDECIDED: a rater's ctrl814 not rows (and no FAILS from the other); or no 814 guard called not rows (lenient)

rule.descriptive_L85: if FAILS-814 and both valid raters read L85_814 rows, write 'this window read with ~15 % deep hops, not ~30 %'; the Judge requires the follow-on: 'the same raters read the heavier 45 % picture rows for 1 of 2'

stage0.INCONCLUSIVE (reader still reaches): Stage 0b fails at floor 140 and again at the 170 fallback (no page)

scope: one window, one picture per level, the same two raters and sitting as fullhop_w (not an independent replication)

stage0.note: 0b failed at floor 140 (reader still reached the true text); the pre-written 170 fallback ran once and passed
